caption:
Mr Turtle signed up for night classes. Laptop, heavy backpack and three-hour lectures, and his neck and shoulders feel it first.

Hunching over a laptop on a low desk for hours tends to load the neck and upper back. Prop it on a few books and plug in a separate keyboard.

For a long trek across campus, use both straps and pack heavy items close to your back. Stand at lecture breaks, take the stairs, and book two short exercise sessions into your week like a class.

Pain spreading into an arm or leg, pins and needles, numbness or pain building over weeks is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐢
